title: Let wandering end where the Guru leads
summary: The deeper state is not reached by roaming through moods, methods, or explanations. The shabad names the crossing plainly: devotion to the Lord and service to the Guru carry the soul beyond its circling.
takeaway: Stop roaming at the doorway the Guru has already opened.
lifeApplication: When the mind wants a new method because the old obedience feels ordinary, return to the practice the Guru has already made clear. Let one act of devotion interrupt the roam.

source.shortMeaning: Union with the Lord is known through the True Guru and crossed into by devotion and service.
source.lifeApplication: When wandering resumes, return to the place where the Guru meets you.

evidence.coreClaim: The deeper union is known through the True Guru, not by restless roaming.
evidence.turn: The search stops circling when devotion and service become the crossing.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the mind wants a new method because the old obedience feels ordinary, return to the practice the Guru has already made clear. Let one act of devotion interrupt the roam.
